description: This file defines a database migration class for Android's Room persistence library, specifically handling migration from version 19 to 20. It removes a preference key 'branding' from SharedPreferences during migration.

classes.name: Migration_19_20
classes.description: A Room database migration class that removes the 'branding' preference during migration from version 19 to 20.

methods.name: Migration_19_20
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the migration from version 19 to 20 with the application context.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes the migration logic, removing the 'branding' key from SharedPreferences.
